description: This file defines an enum called GLAccountType representing different types of general ledger accounts (Asset, Liability, Equity, Income, Expense). It includes methods for mapping between string representations, integer values, and enum instances, as well as utility methods for checking account types and retrieving min/max values.

classes.name: GLAccountType
classes.description: An enumeration for different types of general ledger accounts

methods.description: Maps a string to the corresponding GLAccountType enum using case-insensitive comparison.

methods.description: Returns the GLAccountType enum corresponding to the provided integer.
